Thomas.multi_year_sequence_analysis: USDA CDL pixel transition tracking reveals that 74% of winter wheat acreage transitions directly into idle fallow cropland for the subsequent crop year, empirically confirming the prevalence of the traditional 14-month wheat–fallow system.

Finney.multi_year_sequence_analysis: USDA CDL transition tracking reveals that 62% of irrigated corn center-pivot parcels remain planted in corn for 3 or more consecutive seasons, confirming monoculture irrigation intensity driving high water extraction rates under Ogallala pumping caps.
